.claude/skills/add-agent-adapter.description: Use when adding support for a new AI coding agent to Gryph, or when changing how an existing agent adapter is wired. Trigger this whenever the user wants to integrate a new agent (for example Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini, Codex, Windsurf, or any other tool), add a new adapter package under agent/, wire agent hook events, or asks how adapters detect, install hooks, parse events, or register.
